name: Acolyte
description: You spent your life in service to a temple, learning sacred rites and serving in ceremonies.
equipment: A holy symbol, a prayer book or prayer wheel, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Artisan
description: You are a member of a guild of skilled craftspeople, expert in a particular trade.
equipment: A set of artisan's tools appropriate to your trade, a letter of introduction from your guild, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Charlatan
description: You have a history of false identities, tall tales, and fantastic schemes.
equipment: A fine set of clothes, a disguise kit, a forgery kit, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Criminal
description: You have a history of breaking the law — small crimes or major offenses, but always dangerous.
equipment: A crowbar, a set of dark common clothes with a hood, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Cultist
description: You belong to a sinister cult devoted to dark powers or forbidden practices.
equipment: A cult symbol, a hooded robe, vestments, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Entertainer
description: You thrive in front of an audience, whether as a musician, dancer, or storyteller.
equipment: A musical instrument, a costume, a belt pouch, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Farmer
description: You grew up close to the land, working fields or herds and learning the rhythms of nature.
equipment: A set of artisan's tools, a sickle, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

name: Guard
description: You served in some kind of organized military, militia, or watch.
equipment: A uniform, a set of common clothes, a horn or whistle, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

name: Guide
description: You have spent years traveling from place to place, learning the paths and peoples of the wilderness.
equipment: A map of your home region, a compass, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion, either in a sheltered retreat or miles from civilization.
equipment: A scroll case stuffed with notes, a winter blanket, a set of common clothes, a herbalism kit, and 5 gp.

name: Merchant
description: You are an experienced trader, accustomed to bargaining, counting coin, and dealing in goods.
equipment: A letter of introduction, a set of fine clothes, an abacus, and a pouch containing 25 gp.

name: Noble
description: You were raised in a noble family of considerable means and influence.
equipment: A set of fine clothes, a signet ring, a scroll of pedigree, and a pouch containing 25 gp.

name: Sage
description: You have spent years learning the lore of the multiverse.
equipment: A bottle of black ink, a quill, a small knife, a letter from a dead colleague, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

name: Sailor
description: You have lived much of your life aboard a ship, braving storms and strange shores.
equipment: A belaying pin (club), 50 feet of silk rope, a lucky charm, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

name: Soldier
description: You served in an organized army or militia, training for battle and following orders.
equipment: An insignia of rank, a trophy from a fallen enemy, a set of bone dice or a deck of cards, a set of common clothes including a belt, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

name: Wayfarer
description: You travel the roads between towns and cities, surviving on your wits and resourcefulness.
equipment: A set of traveler's clothes, a backpack, a bedroll, a mess kit, a tinderbox, 2 daggers, and a pouch containing 10 gp.
